name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-magma
title: Super Mario World - Magma
description:
A simple layer 3 conversion of magma or cave lava. It can be used as a tide which acts like lava or magma (a feature introduced in Lunar Magic 3.10, doesn't work with sprites, sample level cheated) or with the upcoming patch Interaction Line.

To see anything of the level, simply disable layer 3 in Lunar Magic (press 3 on the keyboard).
